measurements.point_heights: Every distinct selected rational point, both PARI and Sage canonical-height algorithms, 128-bit precision
measurements.pair_control: Canonical-height parallelogram residual for all 20 accepted pairs
measurements.torsion: Sage rational torsion subgroup order on every selected curve
measurements.rank: Sage Simon two-descent rank_bounds with known selected points and limbigprime=0
measurements.host_tier: ordinary local correctness diagnostic; no wall-time comparison

status_rules.rank_timeout: Preserve timeout row and leave full rank unresolved
status_rules.rank_error: Preserve error row and leave full rank unresolved
status_rules.rank_interval: Report lower and upper bounds separately unless equal
status_rules.height: PARI and Sage values are numerical estimates; retain crosscheck and parallelogram residuals
status_rules.claim_boundary: Selected 20-pair finite panel only; no uniform height bound across the xedni selection law
